game.genre: 第三人稱風格化奇幻競技場動作遊戲（stylized fantasy arena brawler）
game.art_direction: Stylized PBR：手繪感配色 + 物理正確的粗糙度/金屬度，大色塊、清楚剪影，3~5 頭身偏英雄比例

characters.shape_language: 方形 / 上重下輕的倒梯形：寬肩、大圓肩甲、粗短四肢 → 穩重、可靠
characters.flux_prompt: Full body 3D game character concept art, stylized hand-painted PBR style like a modern fantasy arena game, a stocky armored human knight with huge round steel shoulder pauldrons, crimson tabard with gold trim, brass belt buckle, short brown beard, open-face steel helmet, round wooden shield with brass rim on left arm, large two-handed war hammer in right hand, standing in A-pose, front view, symmetrical, full body visible from head to boots, plain pure white background, centered, soft even studio lighting, clean silhouette, no ground shadow
characters.notes: 盾牌與錘頭是剪影辨識點；紅色布料與鋼鐵形成材質對比
characters.sd_prompt: 3d stylized cartoon knight character, pixar style, chunky heroic proportions, full body, big round steel shoulder pauldrons, red tabard, short brown beard, steel helmet, round wooden shield, war hammer, standing A-pose, front view, isolated on white background, game character turnaround

characters.shape_language: 三角形 / 細長：尖兜帽、長披風、長法杖 → 敏捷、神秘
characters.flux_prompt: Full body 3D game character concept art, stylized hand-painted PBR style like a modern fantasy arena game, a slender young female arcane ranger wearing an emerald green hooded cloak with gold trim, brown leather bodice, belt with small pouches, tall leather boots, holding a tall wooden staff topped with a glowing cyan crystal in her right hand, standing in A-pose, front view, symmetrical, full body visible from head to boots, plain pure white background, centered, soft even studio lighting, clean silhouette, no ground shadow
characters.notes: 發光水晶是視覺焦點（emissive）；綠/金 vs 紅/鋼，兩角色互補色
characters.sd_prompt: 3d stylized cartoon young woman mage character, pixar style, full body, green hooded cloak, long sleeve green tunic, brown trousers, leather boots, fully clothed, wooden staff with glowing blue crystal, standing A-pose, front view, isolated on white background, game character turnaround

characters.shape_language: 圓＋流線：鮑伯頭、大蝴蝶結、飄動圍巾、短百褶裙 → 輕快、親和
characters.sd_prompt: anime style 3d game character, cel shaded, full body, young woman archer, short blue bob hair with a big ribbon, white and sky blue outfit with gold trim, short pleated skirt, dark leggings, white boots, long scarf, holding a white bow, standing A-pose, front view, isolated on white background
characters.notes: 原創角色；日系卡通渲染（cel shading）＋描邊

characters.shape_language: 尖角＋垂直：刺蝟頭、長馬尾、高領長大衣、長槍 → 銳利、強勢
characters.sd_prompt: anime style 3d game character, cel shaded, full body, young man spearman, spiky black hair with red streaks and a long ponytail, black long coat with gold trim, red sash, high collar, black boots, holding a long red spear, standing A-pose, front view, isolated on white background
characters.notes: 原創角色；日系卡通渲染（cel shading）＋描邊

characters.shape_language: 圓形：大頭、丸子頭、蓬裙、馬卡龍 → 可愛、親和
characters.notes: 原創；Q版潮玩公仔風（亮面 clearcoat）

characters.shape_language: 倒梯形＋切角：寬肩大胸、窄腰、粗壯小腿 → 力量、可靠
characters.notes: 原創；科幻硬表面（白/橘/海軍藍 + 青色發光）
